title: Kagamine Rin — Unspeakable Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I didn't realize just how serious you all were.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though you played as hard as you could today, I wasn't willing to listen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm gonna play like I mean it.
So, let's make our next performance one to remember...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try to keep up with me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Keeping up with Shiho isn't going to be easy, is it...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this is just the first day.
For now, let's keep watching over them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you that worried about them Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
There's that, but also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's so hard to be kind and thoughtful to someone in just the right way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: H-Hang on... Am I the only one who feels this way?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry.
I didn't mean that in a condescending way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we both felt that we all seem to think the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The same way...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember that story from the other day about what happened to the girls after they reformed Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like they were scattered to the wind. They didn't even talk to each other much at school.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing how they are now, I can't imagine that at all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even after that, on more than one occasion, they've sort of butted heads after trying to reach out to one another.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Their becoming so distant from each other was also because they believed that's what was best for them, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But their thoughts and feelings are what pushed them to reform their band, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, what did you mean by more than one occasion?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, have we not told you about what happened at the choir recital?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Choir recital?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That happened just around the time I arrived here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see, so you were fretting about something that happened in class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was really trying to think things through with me. Saki saw that I was feeling down and wanted to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho said some harsh things too, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are many different ways of expressing kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can empathize with someone who's troubled about something, make them smile or be somewhat direct.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As long as it was done with that person's best interests at heart, no matter what form it takes, it's a form of kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's also important to consider how the other person will take it too, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Different ways of expressing kindness...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami became so worried that time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, Shiho was beating herself up about saying some really harsh things to Honami again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those two express kindness in such different ways. You could even say they're polar opposites in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... Honami likes to wrap you in her kindness, while Shiho's kindness involved being blunt and telling you the cold, hard truth at times...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. I can't say if that was the main reason, but they did also manage to clear their ticket quota.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, didn't that happen when Len and I were having a huge fight...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The girls care about each other very much, but they experienced a period when they weren't all together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As a result, despite their intentions, having strong feelings for one another can lead to disagreements...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be fair, the road to true friendship is paved with fights and arguments.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len told me not to push myself too hard for the same reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Fights and arguments are natural outcomes of wanting the best for one another.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Kindness is such a deep subject...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
